person_note: The book alternates narrative person by sustained chapter strand. Michael Bennett’s chapters are unmistakably first person: numerous Goodreads passages expose his participating “I,” and two authorized publisher-hosted versions of the opening confirm that mode across several chapters. Separate excerpts externally narrate the consciousness and history of Alice and Christoph in third person, while whole-book chapter coverage corroborates that these perspectives recur at many points rather than appearing as dialogue, documents, or isolated embedded tales. The result is therefore ALTERNATING, not FIRST with incidental third-person references. Confidence is medium because the strongest authorized web excerpts cover only the first-person opening; the recurring third-person structure is established chiefly by the quote set plus a weaker whole-book chapter source.
